extracted.name: Maple-Pecan-Crusted Chicken
extracted.description: This maple-pecan-crusted chicken recipe is quick, easy, and full of fall sweet and savory flavors like pure maple syrup, pecans, mayonnaise, and panko.
ingredient_lines: 4 medium skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into strips
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place a wire rack onto a baking sheet and lightly coat with cooking spray.
Combine maple syrup, mayonnaise, and salt in a bowl. Combine panko and pecans in a separate bowl.
Dip chicken in syrup mixture, then press into panko mixture. Place breaded chicken onto the prepared rack. Repeat with remaining chicken.
Bake in the preheated oven until an instant-read thermometer inserted into centers reads at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), 15 to 20 minutes.
